notes.title: Agent of Strange - Reveal
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, everyone. 

For a long time, we stayed in the shadows – no announcements, no whispers. But now, the veil is lifting. We step out of the darkness to reveal the project we’ve been working on for the past year: [b]Agent of Strange[/b], a dark role-playing thriller where every mission is a labyrinth of choices and possibilities.

This game is published by [b]HypeTrain Digital[/b], a partner who shares our vision of stories.

[/p][h1]Watch the Official Announcement Trailer below[/h1][previewyoutube="jK0q4D9DLyM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Agent of Strange[/b] casts you as an undercover agent of the Conspiracy, sent to infiltrate a sealed city ruled by the mysterious Traum Family. A place where every shadow hides a secret, and every choice can tip the scales of power.

[/p][h1]What makes Agent of Strange special?[/h1][p]
[b]Infiltrate the city:[/b] Go undercover in a surreal early 20th-century metropolis controlled by the Traum Family—aristocrats who opened the forbidden Red Door and returned… changed. Now they impose alien laws, reshape reality, and erase anyone who resists.

[b]Shape your identity:[/b] Choose who you become. Spy, saboteur, charlatan, revolutionary, loyalist—or something far darker. No path is fixed. No mask is permanent.

[b]Narrative sandbox gameplay:[/b] The game reacts to your actions in real time. Every mission, encounter, and moment of silence can shape your role and redefine your goals.

[b]Living world: [/b]Citizens have their own lives, loyalties, and agendas. They can become your allies… or report you. Time passes. Events unfold. And every failure leaves a mark.

[b]Dynamic consequences:[/b] No two playthroughs will be the same. Your story is built from your own choices, mistakes, betrayals, and shifting power structures.

[b]Survive by any means: [/b]Gather forbidden knowledge, forge fragile alliances, and dive into conspiracies layered so deep they begin to rewrite what you know about the world—and yourself.

We’d be happy if you add [b]Agent of Strange[/b] to your wishlist and follow the development here on Steam to stay up to date on all future updates and reveals.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3855850/Agent_of_Strange"][/dynamiclink] 

The game is dark, but your choices will light the way.

Sincerely yours,

Sever team
